impacts.description: Emergency services continue working on clearing debris

evidence.quote: Emergency services continue working on clearing debris on the first day of official mourning after the devastating storm, on a day when the Prime Minister, Pedro Sánchez, is visiting Valencia to learn about the state of the emergency work.

impacts.description: 3,400 rescues carried out by the Civil Guard

evidence.quote: The Civil Guard has carried out 3,400 rescues since last Tuesday in the affected areas in the province of Valencia and it is estimated that some 300 people are still isolated, in addition to those whose whereabouts are unknown in provinces such as Albacete, at least five.

impacts.description: 13 people died in La Torre and Castellar

evidence.quote: On the other hand, a total of thirteen people have died in the districts of La Torre and Castellar in the city of Valencia, eight of whom were found in a garage, according to the mayor, María José Catalá.
